item.title: Accora 0.9.0
item.description:
• Add Add to group (Tools → Customers, Option-Command-G): add customers who carry selected Zalo labels to one or more groups or communities across many accounts in a single confirmed run.
  • Choose several accounts, groups and labels in one form; groups shared by several accounts and labels with the same name are merged automatically.
  • Preview the automatic plan by account, by group or per customer before sending; exclude customers or change the sending account.
  • Each customer is invited by exactly one account, preferring an account that is already their friend, and a permanent invite ledger prevents the same customer from being invited to the same group twice, including on reruns.
  • Send in the background with per-account limits, spacing between requests, Pause, Resume and Stop; members already in a group are skipped right before sending.
  • Show per-customer results: added, invite link sent (communities), invitation sent, pending approval, already a member, rejected, not sent or uncertain. Uncertain requests are never resent automatically, and a read-only check can confirm who joined.
  • Add the Group invite history page (Option-Shift-Command-G) with search and account/result filters.

item.title: Accora 0.8.1
item.description:
• Fix automatic account synchronization after QR login, so the Zalo profile updates without manually reloading the page.
  • Restore manual synchronization for an open account that has not saved its first profile yet, and keep the QR login page available after sign-out.
  • Capture fresh login context from the current browser, preserve the provisional owner during account updates, and verify the native profile before saving account information.
  • Add clearer login synchronization diagnostics while retaining native owner, proxy-route, account-lease and request-journal safeguards.
  • Separate Create Campaign from Created Campaigns in the Sidebar and enlarge the fixed Accounts/Tools navigation controls.
  • Remove the Sidebar footer Add Account button and enlarge its Open Web and Unread filter controls.
  • Replace trailing detail panels with shared, scrollable popups and remove duplicate actions; detail-only actions stay in a fixed footer with at most two commands.
  • Keep withdrawal account tables consistent with native multi-selection, retain the original table appearance, and correct stale selection ranges during Command-click.

item.title: Accora 0.8.0
item.description:
• Add recurring friend-request jobs that select customers directly from Contacts, with a default daily time of 06:00, category filters, account selection and per-account quotas.
  • Preview allocations before running, share available daily capacity across due jobs, and prevent duplicate runs for the same schedule and day.
  • Add a dedicated schedule monitor and separate run history with multi-select column filters and detailed allocation results.
  • Offer a shared catch-up countdown for eligible missed schedules and preserve the existing account active-hour, native authorization and duplicate-send safeguards.
  • Improve concurrent scheduling, prepared database writes and bounded API/step journals for larger workloads.
  • Split the Sidebar into Accounts and Tools, with fixed bottom-left navigation tabs, trailing action icons and search available in both modes.
  • Group tools clearly, distinguish sending, scheduling and withdrawal histories, and remove static warehouse-count badges.
  • Make the Menu Bar more compact with explicit notification counts, bounded quick-account lists, overflow navigation and scheduling controls.
  • Consolidate global background, notification and power preferences into the five-tab Settings window; keep automation configuration focused on sending behavior.
  • Improve pinned-account notifications and background window handling while preserving existing account sessions and stored preferences.
  • Remove duplicate Quick Open and Focus Mode toolbar icons while retaining their menu commands and keyboard shortcuts.

item.title: Accora 0.7.0
item.description:
• Schedule campaigns by weekday with up to three daily time windows, including overnight windows and account-specific schedules.
  • Choose immediate or scheduled execution when confirming a campaign; refresh saved schedules and daily limits before confirmation.
  • Keep native campaigns and withdrawals running while the screen is locked or off, with configurable idle-sleep prevention.
  • Add launch-at-login controls and optional unfinished-campaign recovery after account synchronization and a cancellable countdown.
  • Fix manual Resume outside sending hours and distinguish daily-limit pauses from closed-window waits.
  • Restore the original waiting or rest deadline after Pause and Resume.
  • Batch local API and step journals, reduce Monitor update work, and limit campaign recovery verification to four concurrent requests.
  • Batch campaign start and Stop All persistence while preserving native authorization checks and duplicate-send protection.

item.title: Accora 0.6.6
item.description:
• Fix overlapping account rows in withdrawal setup and progress lists while preserving compact table density.
  • Restore outcome colors in send history and secondary styling for uncategorized Contacts.
  • Restore mouse-drag range selection and edge autoscroll in multi-select tables, including withdrawal account choices.
  • Fix Command-click additions and removals after range selection; keep dragging responsive by committing selection work once on release.
  • Keep selected text and symbols readable when focus moves between a table, search, filters and inspectors.
  • Improve column-header truncation, full-title tooltips and spacing around filter buttons.
  • Give timestamps and severity labels more room in system logs, and identify UID-only history recipients clearly.
  • Preserve paged loading, bounded cell reuse and large-dataset optimizations.

item.title: Accora 0.6.5
item.description:
• Fix long campaign preparation when selected Contacts are near the end of a large address book.
  • Speed up campaign source counts and previews with database indexes, direct recipient lookup and validated caching.
  • Reduce database write contention during source preparation and limit the recipient window before assigning campaign order.
  • Move bulk withdrawal sorting, search, selection preparation and confirmation reviews off the interface thread.
  • Fix expensive withdrawal context-menu selection lookups and preserve hidden selections when filtering.
  • Keep withdrawal confirmation lists virtualized and add clearer operation timing diagnostics.

item.title: Accora 0.6.4
item.description:
• Speed up Friends synchronization with indexed, set-based Contact linking instead of per-friend Contact scans.
  • Keep Friends search, filters and sorting responsive with bounded page reads, canceled obsolete projections and cached summary metadata.
  • Reduce unnecessary in-memory table redraws and preserve exact range selections when individual rows are excluded.
  • Improve native table filter accessibility, popup placement and sizing.
  • Include virtualized list rendering and bounded Contacts reads introduced after 0.6.3.
  • Verify saved native account contexts at startup before using a bounded WebKit bootstrap when needed.

item.title: Accora 0.6.3
item.description:
• Fix shared-friend detection to compare Zalo global identity across accounts instead of account-local user IDs.
  • Keep each source account and its local UID for chat and friendship actions.
  • Show missing identity coverage and sync guidance for older cached lists.
  • Include separate local UID and Global ID columns in Friends CSV exports.

item.title: Accora 0.6.2
item.description:
• Select multiple friends and review their source accounts before removing friendships with native Zalo API.
  • Filter friends shared by multiple accounts, with account counts and grouped ordering.
  • Keep selections across searches and filters, and expose bulk actions in the menu bar.
  • Record per-friend failures and continue the batch without automatically retrying a removal. Confirm uncertain results through read-only reconciliation.
  • Preserve Contacts and send history while updating confirmed relationship changes.

item.title: Accora 0.6.1
item.description:
• Visible withdrawal headers and first row: fix native inspector placement that could make macOS cover the invitation table header and clip the first recipient, even when details were closed.
  • Stable recipient details: keep the inspector at the workspace boundary so opening or closing details preserves the table, step navigation and footer.
  • Clearer compact layout: move the parallel-account control to a separate row when space is limited, keeping step names and the control readable.

item.title: Accora 0.6.0
item.description:
• New Friends workspace: browse cached Zalo friends across accounts with avatars, names, phone numbers or UIDs, source accounts, Contacts matches and last synchronization times.
  • Native friend synchronization: synchronize all signed-in accounts or one selected account, with bounded concurrency, per-account results and cancellation. Unsigned accounts are skipped.
  • Contacts cross-reference: match by validated UID or nonconflicting phone, show the owning accounts and support friendships with multiple accounts. Import selected friends in bulk, including friends whose phone number is hidden.
  • Immediate relationship updates: native campaign checks save confirmed friend or pending-invitation relationships before skipping the recipient; acknowledged invitations also record the source account. Existing profile-first persistence and duplicate protection remain intact.
  • Faster friend management: search by name, phone or UID; filter in column headers; identify friends shared across accounts; open the correct account's conversation without sending a message; export the complete filtered list to CSV.
  • Consistent macOS presentation: use the Contacts-style native table, trailing toolbar search, anchored filters, compact account links and menu-bar commands.

item.title: Accora 0.5.9
item.description:
• Skip withdrawal error 301: record the failed invitation and original server code, show a skipped-error notice, and continue with the next recipient of the same account. A rejected invitation no longer stops the entire account.
  • Keep processing predictable: each failed item is skipped without automatic retry, with normal pacing between recipients. Uncertain POST results retain duplicate protection; account authorization, Pause/Stop, preparation and audit safeguards remain in place.
  • Respect the reviewed order: withdrawal confirmation now preserves the recipient sort order chosen in the table. The default unknown-date-first, then oldest-first selection remains unchanged.
  • Keep errors visible: withdrawal history and native System Log retain the rejection details, and progress distinguishes failed invitations from successful withdrawals.

item.title: Accora 0.5.8
item.description:
• Save discovered Zalo profiles first: native campaign lookups persist UID, name and available profile fields before checking relationships or moving to another contact. Existing friends, pending invitations and the current account now update the address book too. Persistence failures block further processing and retain detailed error evidence.
  • Select withdrawal accounts faster: step 1 now has a visible Select All / Deselect All action. It follows the current search, skips unavailable accounts and preserves selections outside the visible results.
  • Use native HTTP for sending and withdrawal: startup verifies signed-in accounts through native profile, captures account-scoped context and releases temporary browsers. Unsigned profiles are skipped; user-opened browsers retain ownership. Native operations reuse verified context without keeping background WebViews open.
  • Inspect complete native evidence locally: System Log displays cURL, request and response before/after encryption, context and processing errors. General diagnostics and support exports remain filtered.
  • Preserve operational safeguards: per-recipient errors are recorded and skipped, withdrawal 301 stops only its account, and uncertain POST results retain duplicate protection without automatic replay. The retired SDK/DOM sender is removed.

item.title: Accora 0.5.7
item.description:
• Skip API item errors: record recipient-processing failures and continue the campaign, including new business codes, read/transport failures, restrictions and uncertain send results. Remove automatic item retries and consecutive-error pauses for API recipients while keeping normal pacing, active hours and daily-limit gates.
  • Stop withdrawal on 301: when Zalo reports its withdrawal limit, save the error and stop only that account without retry. Other recorded per-recipient withdrawal failures are skipped so the remaining items and other accounts can proceed.
  • Keep useful error details: preserve the server code and SDK method, store the failed result once, and show readable skipped notices and journal results.
  • Preserve duplicate protection: skipping an uncertain send or withdrawal retains its durable reservation. It does not retry the POST or assert that the server definitely rejected it.

item.title: Accora 0.5.6
item.description:
• Continue past lookup error 210: when Zalo confirms that a recipient is blocked for a policy violation, record the recipient failure and continue the queue. Apply the same verified pre-dispatch checks already used for lookup errors 212 and 216.
  • Keep the failure final: save the exact lookup reason once, advance processed count without counting a send, and use the configured pause before the next recipient. An empty remaining queue finishes immediately.
  • Make skipped recipients clear: show a dedicated skipped badge and result filter in the API journal, with a readable error-210 explanation in Monitor and history. Unresolved failures retain their separate status.

item.title: Accora 0.5.5
item.description:
• Close withdrawal progress windows: fix the Close and Collapse buttons to dismiss the correct window. Escape uses the same action; hiding progress leaves its worker running.
  • Show why a withdrawal stopped: display the terminal error near the progress bar and identify invitations that were not processed. Open the rejecting recipient's last SDK step automatically instead of leaving a successful list request selected.
  • Report failed accounts correctly: a terminal error no longer appears as completed, including when Zalo rejects the last recipient. Clear previous failure notices when starting a new run.
  • Improve local diagnostics: retain the original failure reason and add internal batch, operation, server-code and remaining-count context to help investigate failures.

item.title: Accora 0.5.4
item.description:
• A dedicated withdrawal workspace: open Withdrawal or History directly from their own sidebar group. Select accounts, automatically load outgoing invitations, then review the combined recipient list before confirming.
  • Fewer selection steps: automatically select up to 60 pending invitations per account, prioritizing unknown send dates and then the oldest invitations. Change the default quantity in Configuration, including account-specific settings, or adjust the selection before withdrawal.
  • Clearer recipient review: show available Zalo recipient avatars, compact single-line rows, account/date header filters and one toolbar search. Keep selections across filters and display recipients immediately under compact account headers in the confirmation step.
  • Compact withdrawal history: view history across accounts, filter by Zalo account name/avatar, and use the same table density as Contacts and send history. Existing history cleanup and Undo remain available.
  • Continue past invalid API recipients: record observed Zalo lookup failures 212/216 as recipient errors and move to the next contact with a non-blocking Monitor notice. Explicit recipient privacy restrictions and incoming requests are also skipped. Session, account, SDK-contract and uncertain-send problems retain their existing protection.
  • Keep recorded failures final: an exhausted transient error is no longer returned to pending when the account pauses at its consecutive-error threshold. Preserve the recorded result instead of retrying that contact.

item.title: Accora 0.5.3
item.description:
• Multi-account withdrawal: select multiple accounts, load their outgoing invitations in parallel, and review recipients before confirming. Run 1–5 accounts at a time, with a default of 3, and monitor, pause, or stop individual accounts or the entire batch.
  • Withdrawal history cleanup: delete selected records, filtered results, one account's history, or history across all accounts, with confirmation and a 5-second Undo action. Safety records for uncertain withdrawal results continue to prevent duplicate requests.
  • Cleaner withdrawal layout: separate account selection and invitation lists, keep the header and action bar fixed, and review recipients by account in the same sheet. Fix excessive blank space when the account selection is cleared.
  • More reliable invitation loading: handle older invitations without a send date from Zalo and label them as having an unknown send date instead of rejecting the entire list.
  • Correct filter popover placement: open filters directly below their buttons and keep them aligned with the relevant column when the window is resized.

item.title: Accora 0.5.2
item.description:
• Tự chuẩn bị phiên Zalo: khi web đang đóng hoặc hiện “Kích hoạt”, Accora tự mở đúng phiên đã lưu, gọi hàm kích hoạt nội bộ của Zalo và xác minh tài khoản trước khi tải danh sách hoặc thực hiện tác vụ. Không cần thoát Accora; phiên đã hết đăng nhập vẫn cần người dùng đăng nhập lại.
  • SDK/API cho chiến dịch: các lần chạy tiếp theo dùng API Zalo Web, kể cả tiếp tục chiến dịch cũ. Lịch sử và cấu hình chụp trước đây được giữ nguyên. Không tự chuyển sang bấm giao diện khi SDK thay đổi.
  • Đổi proxy trong ứng dụng: làm mới kết nối mà không cần thoát app. Các tác vụ bị ảnh hưởng được dừng an toàn; nếu có tác vụ đã dừng, ứng dụng hỏi có muốn tiếp tục sau khi xác minh kết nối mới.
  • Sửa bố cục: xác nhận xóa chiến dịch dùng alert native và phản hồi ở footer cố định; các nhóm input trong Cấu hình căn sát bên phải, gồm mục Áp dụng cho và Nhịp gửi.

item.title: Accora 0.5.1
item.description:
• Mật khẩu proxy cục bộ: lưu plaintext trên máy theo lựa chọn người dùng, có hiện/ẩn mật khẩu đã lưu. Mật khẩu Keychain cũ được chuyển một lần sau khi được cấp quyền; những lần đọc sau dùng bản đã lưu cục bộ.
  • Nhập nhiều proxy: dán mỗi dòng theo định dạng IP:Port:Username:Password, kiểm tra trước khi nhập và chọn bỏ qua hoặc thay thế proxy trùng IP + Port. Thay thế giữ nguyên tên, ghi chú và tài khoản gán; lỗi kiểm tra kết nối không tự chuyển sang mạng trực tiếp.
  • Bảo toàn cấu hình: giữ bundle ID và vị trí dữ liệu Release qua cập nhật. Lỗi khóa tệp, quyền truy cập hoặc dung lượng không còn bị coi là database hỏng rồi tạo kho rỗng. Cài đặt hiển thị thư mục dữ liệu đang dùng.
  • Phân bổ danh bạ: tạo chiến dịch tự chọn danh bạ Chưa gửi, lọc nhanh theo phân loại và chia đều trong hạn mức riêng còn lại của tài khoản. Có xem trước danh sách người nhận trước khi chạy.

item.title: Accora 0.5.0
item.description:
• Consistent lists: Contacts, History, Campaigns, Proxy, System Log and invitation lists share one toolbar search and column-header filters/sorting. Search and actions align to the right; columns fill the available width, with ellipses and full-value tooltips instead of horizontal scrolling. Empty search results retain the filters and reset action.
  • Invitation withdrawal: choose an account, load outgoing invitations, select recipients and review confirmation before withdrawing. The app checks the current relationship and verifies the server result; quota rejections and uncertain responses are recorded without blindly retrying.
  • Durable withdrawal history: results and request/response diagnostics remain available after reopening the app. Detail sheets scroll while keeping their title and Close button visible.
  • Native layouts and navigation: cleaner tables, grouped forms, adaptive inspectors, stable sidebar selection, searchable account popovers and consistent menu/keyboard commands. Settings use number fields without stepper arrows and a hyphen between range endpoints.
  • Campaign defaults: new drafts select API Zalo Web first. Existing campaigns retain their saved execution mode and message snapshots.

item.title: Accora 0.4.1
item.description:
• Proxy Keychain recovery: explicit connection checks and assignment can ask macOS to authorize access to the saved password. Keychain reads run off the UI thread, and authorization errors are distinguished from a missing password.
  • Safe reconnection: a blocked assigned session can reconnect after a successful check while keeping the proxy assignment, credential reference and persistent Zalo store. Checking a healthy route preserves its live document. Background credential failures are shown as errors, with no direct-network fallback.
  • Shared message templates: manage multiple friend-request messages in Cấu hình chung. Save text and enabled states once for all new campaigns; add, delete, enable/disable, insert variables and preview random selection. Account-specific timing settings cannot override the shared messages.
  • Simpler campaign creation: the campaign form shows the shared-message summary and a link to Settings. Existing campaigns keep their original message snapshots.
  • API monitor filters: result/API labels appear inside their native selectors; search, result and API fields use a responsive 4:2:2 layout, with actions on a separate row when space is limited.

item.title: Accora 0.4.0
item.description:
• API monitor redesign: account/campaign/proxy context, progress, result/API filters and phone/name/UID search; a responsive recipient tree and four-tab inspector show each SDK call.
  • Request and response inspection: view SDK arguments, available HTTP status/headers and original response, the complete decrypted business envelope, the SDK return value, timing and errors. Copy individual calls or export the loaded account/campaign journal as JSONL.
  • Empty response explanation: a successful send ACK may contain `data: ""`. The inspector now separates that SDK return value from the complete response envelope and explains older records that did not capture it.
  • Persistent local journal: new calls are stored locally with account/campaign scope, bounded payload previews, credential-field redaction, queue limits and retention. Completed API campaigns can reopen their journal without restarting automation.
  • Chat access: switch between the API journal and the same account's Zalo Web session without recreating its WebView. API mode permits manual chat interaction while retaining Pause/Stop execution leases; interface mode retains its interaction lock.
  • Native controls: compact search with an exterior focus ring, responsive inspector navigation, independent JSON scrolling, retained filters/selection and matching menu commands.

item.title: Accora 0.3.0
item.description:
• Campaign execution mode: choose “Thao tác giao diện” or “API Zalo Web” in the native campaign form or Campaign menu. The confirmation sheet shows the selected mode before starting.
  • Preserved campaign behavior: the execution mode is saved with the campaign settings snapshot. Existing campaigns continue using the interface flow; API is opt-in for new campaigns.
  • API recipient checks: identify the current Zalo account and look up recipients through its authenticated WebView session. Skip self, existing friends and pending invitations; distinguish invalid phone input from unavailable profiles.
  • Fresh message mapping: synchronize the recipient profile before rendering a greeting, then recheck identity, profile and relationship before dispatch. Unknown gender/birthday fields remain unknown.
  • Duplicate-send protection: acquire execution locks before asynchronous preflight, persist unresolved send reservations, and reconcile uncertain outcomes with read requests instead of automatically resending. Pause/Stop revoke execution permission.
  • Monitor mode: API campaign details identify their execution mode and display API-specific attention messages alongside the existing runner history.
  • Developer documentation: document the inspected Zalo modules, preflight decisions, and sequence diagrams; organize the fixed SDK script into named functions with explanatory comments.

item.title: Accora 0.2.1
item.description:
• Proxy table fits the window: remove the forced 1,040-point width and outer horizontal scrolling. Column widths adapt to available space; secondary columns collapse when needed and their information remains available in the inspector.
  • Proxy blank clicks: clicking empty table space no longer reopens the previous selection's detail panel. Clearing selection closes the inspector; selecting a proxy and native row/context-menu actions still open its details.
  • Compact Contacts toolbar: separate the search field from the buttons' shared toolbar background on macOS 26, preventing focus-ring padding from enlarging the whole group.
  • Consistent History toolbar: use native icon-only actions and the same search sizing as Contacts. Keep export/cancel-export, cleanup, tooltips, and menu commands.
  • Search focus and resizing: retain the 210×32-point search input with space for the native exterior focus ring; long text stays inside the field.

item.title: Accora 0.2.0
item.description:
• Per-account HTTP CONNECT proxies: manage saved proxies, automatically parse connection details, test connectivity and public IP, and assign a separate proxy to each Zalo account. Credentials are stored in Keychain; assignments persist across app restarts.
  • Verified proxy routing: compare native and WebKit egress before allowing an assigned session to load. Invalid routes or unavailable credentials block the affected account instead of silently using a direct connection. Connection changes wait for a safe automation pause.
  • Three-step contact imports: import CSV, XLSX, and supported XLS files with column mapping, a data preview, configurable phone-prefix conversion, validation, duplicate detection, and a final review before saving.
  • Contact categories and filters: create and manage colored categories, assign multiple contacts, and combine per-column filters. Status and category popovers support multiple selections with checkboxes.
  • Compact native Contacts UI: five primary columns, smaller icon-only toolbar actions, bounded search with an exterior native focus ring, and responsive import sheets. Gender and birthday remain available in contact details and CSV exports.
  • Campaign names: name campaigns, use presets or a date-based default, and rename saved campaigns. History displays the campaign name.
  • History management: seven columns, native multiple selection, copying rows, scoped cleanup, and a five-second Undo. Hiding history does not reset send quotas or duplicate-send protection.

item.title: Accora 0.1.10
item.description:
• Skip your own account: when a search result matches the logged-in Zalo UID, record “Bỏ qua — Chính tài khoản này” and continue the campaign instead of stopping at `profileChat`.
  • Recover from an open self profile: close the verified own-account popup left by an earlier attempt before searching again. Unrelated manual profiles remain protected.
  • Account-specific results: self skips apply only to that campaign/account assignment, consume no send quota, and do not mark the contact as your own account globally.
  • Pinned messages: distinguish pinned-message previews from friend-request banners so an unrelated chat banner does not prevent friendship classification.
  • History and monitoring: show a separate self-skip result and retain its reason in local history.

item.title: Accora 0.1.9
item.description:
• Business profiles: open Xem thêm to read gender and birthday when Zalo displays them. Use the current detail layout and close the popup correctly before sending from the chat banner.
  • Friend-request flows: support search results that open a profile first, then Nhắn tin. Recognize the chat's Gửi kết bạn action even when the stranger badge or the profile's friend button is absent. Recheck pending requests and recipient identity before confirmation.
  • Fresh personalization: retain name, gender, birthday and {Salutation} mapping from the newly verified profile. Hidden fields are not inferred from stale imports. Existing message templates remain compatible.
  • Bulk contact deletion: select multiple contacts or all matching results, then use Xóa… or Danh bạ → Xóa liên hệ đã chọn… (⌥⌘⌫). Confirmation defaults to Cancel. Contacts still pending/sending in campaigns are kept, and the result shows how many were removed or protected.
  • History preservation: deleting contacts hides them from the address book while retaining send history and daily quotas. Reimporting a deleted number restores its existing identity and refreshes profile data on the next send.
  • Diagnostics: known ResizeObserver loop notifications remain visible as `PAGE_LAYOUT_WARNING`. Other JavaScript and promise errors remain recorded, including unresolved website errors. Automation logs identify the profile/chat route taken.

item.title: Accora 0.1.8
item.description:
• System log monitor: open Nhật ký → Nhật ký hệ thống to search, filter, inspect, copy and export diagnostics stored on this Mac. Logs cover app startup, storage, WebKit and campaign execution, with session and operation references. Files rotate at approximately 200 MiB total; secrets are redacted. The table shows the latest 200 matching events while search and export use up to 5,000 recent events.
  • Contact profile columns: Contacts now displays gender and birthday from synced Zalo profiles. Hidden fields stay empty instead of reverting to old imported values.
  • Personalized greetings: insert {Salutation} in campaign or default messages. A freshly read male Zalo profile maps to anh, female to chị, and hidden or unrecognized gender to bạn. Files without gender still import normally. Existing message templates are kept.
  • Safer manual messaging during campaigns: the running account's Zalo view is locked while automation owns it. Tạm dừng để nhắn tin waits for the current operation to hand control back; resuming searches for the recipient and reads their profile again. Other accounts remain usable.
  • Pause and Stop guard the send confirmation: revocable execution permissions are checked before sending. An uncertain result after confirmation is reconciled without automatically sending another invitation.
  • Background execution improvements: stable parking slots, visibility checks, optional WebKit scheduling fallbacks and separate sleep/lock handling improve session control.
  • Editing and performance fixes: message editors preserve text and cursor state while previews update. Filtering stored logs avoids rebuilding thousands of native table rows.

item.title: Accora 0.1.7
item.description:
• Campaigns run in the background: after starting a campaign you can open History, Contacts, Settings or another account, or switch to a different app. Sending continues. Previously sending stopped with "Trang Zalo bị ẩn" or "recipientChanged" unless the account's Zalo page stayed on screen.
  • Safer when the page is hidden: if the Zalo page is hidden for a moment, Accora moves it back to its background window and retries. When that happens during sending, it re-reads the chat status on Zalo first, so a request is never sent twice.
  • Recipient checks stay reliable in the background: the hidden Zalo page keeps the normal desktop layout, so verifying the recipient's Zalo profile works the same as on screen.
  • Includes random friend messages, synced Zalo recipient profiles and Zalo account profiles from the previous changes.

item.title: Accora 0.1.6
item.description:
• In-app updates: the "new version" banner and Settings → Update now offer Cập nhật ngay, and Accora → Kiểm tra cập nhật… checks directly. Accora downloads the update, verifies its signature, installs it over the current app and relaunches. No GitHub download, no Gatekeeper "Open Anyway" and no permission prompts on later updates.
  • Stable signing: releases are now signed with a fixed Accora certificate instead of a per-build ad-hoc signature, so macOS keeps the permissions you granted across updates.
  • Safer database updates: before a new version changes the local database, Accora saves a copy as `accora-backup-before-<change>.sqlite` next to `accora.sqlite`.
  • Accounts, Zalo sessions, contacts, campaigns, history and settings are kept when updating.
